name: Karst
author: E. T. Carter
description: A Li River nocturne: a rank of rim-lit karst-tower silhouettes stands across the frame and hangs mirrored in dark still water, the reflection dimmer and broken by slow ripple shimmer, a breathing mist band veiling the towers' waists as the whole skyline drifts past at a slow boat's pace.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Lateral travel speed of the skyline, as if poling slowly downriver; 0 moors the scene.

params.label: Ripple
params.effect: Amplitude of the ripple wobble smearing the reflection, from a dead-calm perfect mirror to a restless broken one.

params.label: Mist
params.effect: Density of the mist band crossing the towers' middles and the depth of its slow breathing; 0 clears the air.

params.label: Tower width
params.effect: Width and spacing of the karst towers in CSS pixels, from a dense pinnacle forest to a few grand monoliths.
